turns.blocker: No live Shopify read was executed because the candidate does not specify a concrete Shopify placement to create or update. A promotional merchandising placement could mean a collection, featured collection, navigation link, theme section, or app-owned resource; the safe write operation and required target are therefore not determinable from the supplied evidence. The evidence also shows the latest stored order is 19 days old, but this is derived from incomplete stored order history (backfillComplete=false), so it cannot by itself establish a complete current-store sales gap.
